name: cyclone_base
description: Base Cyclone for BB [[144,12,12]]: m/2 = 72 traps on one rotation loop, ancillas in-line rather than on spurs, so the loop's only non-straight nodes are degree-2 bends and no junction sits on the rotation path (PLAN §0.5).

provenance.config: n=144, m=144, x=m/2=72 traps; 144 data + 72 ancilla ions
provenance.note: capacity 4 = 2 data + 1 ancilla + 1 slot of rebalance headroom; Cyclone's own §4.1 puts 0..2n/m gates per trap per step

loops.note: the rigid-rotation orbit; one movement template shifts every ion on it

trap.note: general-purpose trap: gate, measure and cool all available

extra.note: one ion of the pair joins the neighbouring chain
the other splits back out; which one realizes the transposition
one ion, one trap to the next; the lowest common denominator move

wiring.note: O(1) DACs: Cyclone's headline wiring claim

curve.label: physical swap of a two-ion crystal: 200 us, < 2 quanta per mode (the bound used as the value)
combine: 128 us, < 1 quantum per mode (the bound used as the value)
one zone pitch, 375 um at 4 m/s (derived: 94 us), the speed at which a Ba-Yb crystal gains <= 0.03 quanta per round trip of four such legs (derived: 0.0075 per leg)
split: 128 us, < 1 quantum per mode (the bound used as the value)

3.label: no extra time or excitation beyond the two 375 um legs it joins: a Ba-Yb crystal crosses at the same 4 m/s, and a whole round trip through it (four legs) adds <= 0.03 quanta, charged on the legs. Measured on an X junction; no Y-junction figure for a Ba-Yb crystal is published

4.label: no extra time or excitation beyond the two 375 um legs it joins: a Ba-Yb crystal crosses at the same 4 m/s, and a whole round trip through it (four legs) adds <= 0.03 quanta, charged on the legs

1q_gate.note: Clifford-averaged infidelity 2.5(1)e-5 on Helios; a single-qubit pi/2 takes 5 us on H0
1q_gate.source: arXiv:2511.05465 Table II; duration arXiv:2003.01293 Table III

cool.note: the 300 us of cooling Helios applies after a shift, before the next gates. It leaves the floor n-bar 0.05 that qccd-noise@2 adds (arXiv:2206.11888, Fig. 3's Ba-Yb experiment); the replay counts heating from 0

gate_swap.note: 3 CX, distance-independent: the logical identity SWAP = CX CX CX, not a measured number

measure.note: Helios's SPAM error, 4.8(6)e-4, is mostly preparation (arXiv:2511.05465 p.7); the vendor's emulator splits it as p_meas 1e-6 and p_init 5e-4, which this block follows (reset.error). 120 us is H0's high-fidelity measurement
measure.source: arXiv:2511.05465 Table II; Quantinuum Helios-1E emulator parameters (p_meas); duration arXiv:2003.01293 Table III

ms_gate.chain_note: the chain-length term of Murali et al. (arXiv:2004.04706 Eq. 1, ISCA 2020): A ~ N/ln N, referenced to the two-qubit gate the fidelity was measured on
ms_gate.note: two-qubit RB infidelity 7.9(2)e-4 on Helios, gate time about 70 us. Error per quantum (derived): Bell-state fidelity 0.993(1) near the ground state and 0.974(1) at n-bar 20(2), the same MS gate (arXiv:0810.0670 Sec. 5.2), i.e. 9.5e-4 per quantum. max_quanta is R7's gate budget, a rule of the boards, not a measurement
ms_gate.source: arXiv:2511.05465 Table II and p.5; arXiv:0810.0670 Sec. 5.2

reset.note: preparation error p_init 5e-4 of the vendor's Helios emulator, the bulk of the measured SPAM 4.8(6)e-4; H0 initialises in 10 us
reset.source: Quantinuum Helios-1E emulator parameters (p_init); arXiv:2511.05465 Table II; duration arXiv:2003.01293 Table III

heating.note: R17: accrues whether or not the ion moves. 29(4) quanta/s, the axial centre-of-mass mode of a Ba-Yb crystal in Quantinuum's junction trap

species.note: Helios pairs each 137Ba+ qubit with one 171Yb+ coolant. T_coh_s (derived) is 1/r for the Helios linear memory rate r = 7.9e-3/s, so the coarse idle estimate of qccd.cost.physical agrees with qccd-noise@2's memory channel

sort_merge.note: one ion of the pair joins the neighbouring chain

sort_split.note: the other splits back out; which one realizes the transposition

shuttle.note: one ion, one trap to the next; the lowest common denominator move
